body.statement: Uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal P_n\), first express all perturbation bounds through \(\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}=\inf_{(i,t)\in G\times W}\sigma_r(M^{it})\). The native and neighborhood-replaced fits satisfy \(|(gH)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}\Delta^{\mathrm{aux}}_{it}|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4\{\sqrt n/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2+n^{-3/2}\})\), and the native estimator obeys \((gH)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G,t\in W}(\widehat M_{it}-M_{it})=L+Q+R_{\mathrm{agg}}\), where \(|Q-B_2|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4/(\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\sqrt n))\), \(|R_{\mathrm{agg}}|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4\{\sqrt n/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2+n^{-3/2}\})\), \(\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^2/\sqrt n)\), \(\Delta_\gamma=O_{\mathbb P}(\sqrt{\log n/m}+\log n/m+\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}+\delta_{\mathrm{fit}}^2)\), \(|\widehat B_2-B_2|=O_{\mathbb P}(\ell_n^4\sqrt n/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2+\Delta_\gamma/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}})\), and \(\sum_i\|\widehat w_{i\cdot}-w_{i\cdot}\|_2^2=o_{\mathbb P}(s^2)\). The term \(R_{\mathrm{agg}}\) contains the cubic, penalty, and native-transfer components fixed by its definition. Since \(c_{\mathrm{loc}}\psi\le\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\le\psi\), substitution changes only constants. Under \(\psi\ge n^{1/2+\eta}H^{1/4}\ell_n^8\), the corresponding remainder-to-standard-error ratios are bounded by terms of orders \(\ell_n^4\sqrt H/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\), \(\ell_n^4n\sqrt H/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}^2\), \(\ell_n^4\sqrt H/n\), and \(\Delta_\gamma\sqrt{nH}/\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\), all \(o_{\mathbb P}(1)\).
body.justification: This is the unresolved bridge from a target-specific, conditionally independent neighborhood-replaced proof device to second-order inference for the native masked optimizer.
body.gap: Choi, Kwon, and Liao prove first-order auxiliary equivalence under independent noise, while Choi and Yuan prove neighborhood deletion for fully observed PCA; neither controls this centered aggregate through a masked proximal map.
body.consumer: The theorem certifies that feasible correction and studentization can be applied to the estimator already used for the SEC Tick Size Pilot panel.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove a simultaneous active-rank neighborhood and a uniform second-order expansion for every implemented masked nuclear-norm fixed point, then control the centered quadratic aggregate, cubic and regularization terms, pretreatment reconstruction, fitted curvature, and fitted influence weights at the theorem's stated rates.
obligation.obstruction: The exact proximal identity is a nonsmooth self-consistency equation. The frozen assumptions and established local differential do not furnish a contraction for its missing-coordinate fixed point or a uniform spectral gap for all native fits. Even pointwise smoothness would not control the signed aggregate because the local fits reuse the same donor and pretreatment observations. Proximal nonexpansiveness alone loses that averaging gain and does not imply the displayed curvature or relative-weight rates.
obligation.attempted: The implemented optimizer was reduced to its exact singular-value-thresholding fixed point; the complete three-block differential and target-coordinate auxiliary separation were retained. The asserted raw rates were converted exactly to the oracle standard-error scale, including the residual-covariance term. A direct Lipschitz or nonexpansive comparison remains too coarse, while treating the unpenalized smooth branch as the native optimizer would assume the missing crux.
